sloka: इह वा मां मृतां कुब्जे णृपायावेदयिष्यसि ।वनं तु राघवे प्राप्तेभरतः प्राप्स्यति क्षितिम्॥२-९-५८॥
transliteration: iha vā māṁ mṛtāṁ kubje ṇṛpāyāvedayiṣyasi ।vanaṁ tu rāghave prāptebharataḥ prāpsyati kṣitim॥2-9-58॥

translations.english: O hunchback, tell the king, either Bharata shall secure the kingdom on Rama's departure to the forest or else I will die here.
